caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair placed against a plain, off-white background. The chair features a curved crest rail at the top, adorned with a painted motif of olive green leaves and a central circular medallion in blue and red, set against a reddish-brown background. Below the crest rail is a narrow slat, also decorated with a subtle horizontal pattern in similar hues. The chair's seat is broad with a slightly concave surface, rendered in a worn reddish-brown color to indicate use and age. The legs are turned and taper downwards, with brass or gold-colored accents at intervals. Stretchers connect the legs, adding structural stability, and the side stretchers run diagonally from the lower legs to the seat. The overall color palette consists mainly of earthy browns, reds, golds, and green, with the use of shadows and highlights to create a three-dimensional appearance. There is a small artist signature in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Painted Chair
